name: X-LAB RS8
why_interesting: X-LAB's current all-round road bike alongside the RS9: an official 7.4 kg Shimano 105 Di2 build with BRANTA C45 UL carbon wheels, a full mainland specification and geometry, and a CNY 21,980 official price. A CNY 10,980 frameset with an 850 g bare frame is also sold.
missing: Official mechanical-shifting compatibility (one owner reports no mechanical cable ports)
Frame lay-up and fork fiber grade beyond the official Toray T800 frame statement
Final dealer stock, delivery total and mainland warranty issuer

official_price.price_basis: R7170 Di2 12S / BRANTA C45 UL complete bike
official_price.conditions: Official retail reference; final price varies by location and delivery method.

source_note: The catalog row uses the official mainland R7170 Di2 / BRANTA C45 UL complete bike. The frameset, one dealer-delivered build and one owner self-build stay separate below. An owner's report that the frame lacks mechanical-shift cable ports is recorded as unconfirmed; it is not applied as a compatibility rule.

facts.complete_weight_basis: Official size-M complete-bike weight without pedals; paint finish may change the result.
facts.frame: X-LAB RS8 carbon frame; official description cites Toray T800 carbon
facts.frame_material: Toray T800 carbon frame per the official description; lay-up and fork fiber grade are unpublished
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official frameset page: unpainted size-M frame without fork and seatpost.
facts.wheels: BRANTA C45 UL carbon; 21 mm inner and 29 mm outer width; Center Lock
facts.cockpit: X-LAB carbon integrated cockpit; size-specific 380–420 mm width and 80–120 mm stem
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L and XL
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 508/360, S 525/370, M 544/380, L 564/390, XL 587/400
facts.mechanical_shifting_report: One owner reports being advised to use electronic shifting because the frame has no mechanical-shift cable ports; XDS has not confirmed this.
